notes.content:
[h1]Free[/h1]
The game has gone free to play forever!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Updated screenshots
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

I have updated the screenshots to show a more recent version of the game, as you can see, I added level signs so that you know what puzzle you are on and which skills you can use to complete that puzzle.

Here is how the level signs look:[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26812872/22308c179bfac5d0f7c1f22ba23f17b578702dfb.jpg[/img]

I also made a new puzzle, the 11th puzzle. In total there will be 15 puzzles with maybe a free expansion later on.

Coming up with puzzle ideas is hard, so if [b]you[/b] have any ideas that could fit in the game, let me know in the comments and you might have a chance to help me develop the game, get your name in the credits as a puzzle designer and of course get the game for free.

[h1]Community[/h1]
If you want you can also join the official Discord of the game to share your ideas and talk with fellow fans:
[url=https://discord.gg/tCYxTgw]Click here to join the Discord![/url]
